Swarm · 1 hex · SM +0 Locust Swarm (Monsters on Automatic; answers SRD 3.5)

A locust swarm is not trying to hurt anybody. It is a wall of insects that strips a season's crop in an afternoon and happens to be crossing the road. The danger is being inside it: blind, deafened, and unable to say anything without eating one.
